Teal = attacker transmission Amber = server transmission Gray = internal/receive firing Green state = completed endpoint
Every omitted source CPN place is zero. State cards retain the whole marking, not independently mixed color sets.
Every retained edge is shown once. Follow the source and target state links to reconstruct any complete correlated route.
